description: Angular component for selecting alias entities in the Thingsboard UI, managing overlay panels, subscriptions, and display logic.

classes.name: AliasesEntitySelectComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing alias entity selection with overlay panel, handling subscriptions, display updates, and user interactions.

methods.name: setupAliasController
methods.description: Sets up subscriptions to alias controller events to update display and alias info.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Lifecycle hook for cleanup, unsubscribing from all subscriptions.

methods.name: openEditMode
methods.description: Opens overlay panel for alias entity selection, creating injector and attaching component.

methods.name: _createAliasesEntitySelectPanelInjector
methods.description: Creates dependency injector for the overlay panel with necessary data and references.

methods.name: updateDisplayValue
methods.description: Updates the display string based on current alias info.

methods.name: updateEntityAliasesInfo
methods.description: Refreshes alias info and determines if selectable alias entities are available.
